name: trench-logic
description: Trench scan logic, live on Escalation with the quota at its ceiling (MaxNetworks 8): the fronts are walked to their end with slots still free, so after RescanSeconds each exhausted front rescans from its hottest trace (log: 'rescanning from its hottest trace') and the stretches already held refuse on overlap (log: 'lies along'). Status snapshots after the first pass and after the rescan window.
